explanation: This is 0 at GO on every trial and about 10 at D2 (sometimes 9 after a1 leads to a rare S2). At D1 it is 10 after a rewarded trial and dips after unrewarded ones, falling further with each loss in a row: about 8-9 after one loss, 5-6 after two and 1-2 after three or more, then it climbs back to about 7 on the first D1 after a reward and to 10 after that.
